info.title: MBNAS Server API
info.description: Canonical public contract of the MBNAS Research Console (/api/v1). The gateway (distribution mbnas-server) serves it to the web console and relays to the core control plane; core console responses, their SSE events and the public export are projected onto these schemas (see x-public-projection), and owner audit data exists only on /core/v1/owner/*. Derived from NAS_Console_API_Contract_20261006.json v1.0.0 (see x-contract-changelog). Candidate row id is evaluation_id; candidate_id is stable across promotions. Values in examples are not measured results.

post.summary: Explicit CPU structure observation of a registry model; the result is stored
post.description: Builds the model on CPU with the backend-specific observation (Ultralytics parse + forward hooks, or native forward hooks for RF-DETR and ETRI hybrid) and returns the document. Only a PASS or FAIL document that carries an observation (the build and forward really ran) is stored under <output_root>/registry_structure/<model_id>/; a static FAIL without observation and an UNVERIFIED document are returned but never overwrite the recorded evidence. Statuses: 200 for PASS, FAIL and UNVERIFIED alike (the answer is in the status field); 404 MODEL_NOT_FOUND; 422 INPUT_SIZE_INVALID for an input_size that is not an integer, below 32 or not a multiple of 32 and, for a native model (RF-DETR, ETRI hybrid), for a multiple of 32 that differs from the fixed resolution of that model (decided from the static declaration before anything is built: no document is returned and nothing is stored); 422 VALIDATION_FAILED for an unknown body field or a body that is not a JSON object.

post.summary: Explicit CPU structure check of a user detector YAML (not stored)
post.description: The model is given as upload_id (browser to gateway: the bytes stored by POST /uploads/model-config); the gateway relays it to core as model_yaml_text + source_sha256, so core never receives a path. model_path (legacy, owner-local deployments) names a YAML (up to 1 MiB) under the server model_yaml_roots / output_roots. Exactly one of upload_id, model_yaml_text (with source_sha256) or model_path. The document is returned and not stored. Statuses: 200 for PASS, FAIL and UNVERIFIED alike; 404 UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND; 409 UPLOAD_CORRUPT; 422 for a rejected request: UPLOAD_ID_INVALID, UPLOAD_NOT_UTF8, SOURCE_SHA256_INVALID, SOURCE_SHA256_MISMATCH, the path codes of the shared server path check (PATH_NOT_ABSOLUTE, PATH_PLACEHOLDER, PATH_TRAVERSAL, PATH_OUTSIDE_ALLOWLIST, PATH_NOT_FOUND, PATH_NOT_READABLE), MODEL_CONFIG_INVALID (not a YAML mapping, not .yaml/.yml, over 1 MiB, unparsable, class_count not a positive integer), INPUT_SIZE_INVALID (input_size not an integer, < 32 or not a multiple of 32), VALIDATION_FAILED (no model, more than one model source, wrong type or unknown field); 507 STORE_UNAVAILABLE.

model_name.description: Optional file name of the uploaded model (used for the scale rule and the document name).

model_path.description: Legacy (owner-local deployments): a YAML (up to 1 MiB) under the server model_yaml_roots / output_roots.

allow_native_fallback.description: Optional, server default false. Opt-in to the native-operator fallback search space when the ETRI mixed pool cannot load; otherwise validation fails with SEARCH_SPACE_UNAVAILABLE. Hashed.

search_space_resolved.description: Server-written in the resolved protocol only (a client value is overwritten); hashed. 1.5.0: {variant} only - no owner-host pool root is recorded.

evaluation_enabled.description: Defaults to true on the server; false selects structural random generation only.

duplicate_scope.description: Resolved-only (written by Validate, hashed). Duplicate architectures are rejected inside one seed journal; seeds never share duplicate detection, which keeps seed independence and replay. Any other requested value is FIELD_INVALID.

postprocess.description: Operating point of the post-processing included in forward_and_postprocess latency (default conf 0.25, iou 0.7, max_det 300 — separate from the AP evaluation floor 0.001). Recorded in latency_scope.

execution_mode.description: Resolved explicitly; absent pilot calibration implies PILOT, not formal completed registered search.

preset.description: e.g. PILOT_SMOKE; absent means the default baseline14 protocol.

resolution.description: Server-written in the resolved protocol only. 1.5.0: paths.<key> carries only the requested path - the realpath on the validating host is never recorded or sent - and resolution.paths is hash-excluded (listed in hash_excluded).

Protocol.description: Attachment nas-policy-design/1.0 body retained as requested provenance; console extension adds web settings. Validate creates immutable actual resolved policy with verified backend/path/budget and declared execution mode. Original DESIGN_EXAMPLE_NOT_EXECUTABLE is not treated as executable by itself.

matching.description: For gt/tp/fn/fp: deterministic one-to-one matching metadata of the same sample and evaluation.

metadata.description: Allowlisted recorded image/configuration identifiers; no internal source or traceback. Unknown sample, epoch or checkpoint remains null.

source_kind.description: 1.5.0: a repaired row is reported with the source it was repaired from (repair folded, DD-A19); never repair.

operation.description: inherit | sample | mutate; a repair is folded into its source (never repair).

effective.description: Observed shapes {c_in, c_out, h_in, w_in, stride, params}.

params.description: YAML row of the block (from, repeats, module, args), its scope and the observed effective shapes. 1.5.0: the search-space slot kind is owner-only and never sent.

module.description: User-model rows (explicit training of a user / baseline YAML; copied from the structure check): the YAML row value at the top level; searched rows carry it in params. Operator name of the row.

from.description: User-model rows (explicit training of a user / baseline YAML; copied from the structure check): the YAML row value at the top level; searched rows carry it in params. from reference(s).

repeats.description: User-model rows (explicit training of a user / baseline YAML; copied from the structure check): the YAML row value at the top level; searched rows carry it in params. Declared repeats.

args.description: User-model rows (explicit training of a user / baseline YAML; copied from the structure check): the YAML row value at the top level; searched rows carry it in params. Declared args.

id.description: Immutable evaluation_id, unique per point and device/rung/checkpoint; provisional row is mutable until evaluation committed

candidate_id.description: Stable architecture candidate ID, retained across promotion

rung.description: L0/L1/L2 for search rungs; FINAL for final retraining rows (comparison_group=final, split = final_eval).

architecture_path.description: 1.5.0 public value: never an absolute host path - the path relative to the run directory (the prefix up to and including the run id segment removed) or, for a file outside the run directory, its file name; the file itself is downloaded through artifacts[] (checkpoint id / artifact id), never by path.

checkpoint_path.description: 1.5.0 public value: never an absolute host path - the path relative to the run directory (the prefix up to and including the run id segment removed) or, for a file outside the run directory, its file name; the file itself is downloaded through artifacts[] (checkpoint id / artifact id), never by path.

evaluation_hash.description: Common evaluator protocol/split/metric signature; excludes candidate/checkpoint to support cohort curves. Individual measurement uses id and checkpoint hash.

split_hash.description: Actual evaluated split hash; null for training-only progress with validation disabled.

epoch_target_total.description: Planned total epochs of the trial, >= 1 when present. Official evaluation (training mode evaluate_only) needs no epoch target: its rows carry epochs 0 and no epoch_target_total; the explicit 0 is recorded only in the run protocol console.extra.training.epoch_target_total (the validated protocol keeps a structural placeholder of 1).

gate.description: Gate decision {eligible, reason_code, checks[{name, passed, value, threshold, op}]}. op is >=, <= or in; for op "in" threshold is a list (e.g. the latency_source check: measured, or calibrated_proxy when proxy_may_certify_final_deployment is true).

candidate_status.description: Mutable architecture candidate state; measurement row status remains EVALUATED after its immutable commit.

progress.description: Live training progress of the provisional row; absent on immutable EVALUATED rows except as history.

revision.description: Superseding revision number of this evaluation record.

architecture_id.description: Alias of architecture_hash (structure identity, not trial identity).

namespace.description: Run namespace, e.g. default or pilot_smoke.

source_kind_legend.description: Optional legend of block source kinds used in blocks[].

ap.description: Copy of the evaluator AP (same value as the row ap).

recall.description: Copy of the evaluator recall (same value as the row recall).

latency.description: Latency record (per-scope statistics, operating point, post-processing, device manifest; the manifest uuid is deprecated like device_uuid).

resolved_recipe.description: Recipe the adapter resolved from the user recipe; adapter-internal keys removed.

device_id.description: Core-issued opaque id of the measuring device (replaces device_uuid).

device_uuid.description: Deprecated in 1.5.0: GPU UUID of a customer (runner) device, kept for 1.4.x readers; replaced by the core-issued device_id (DD-A19 / D7) - the projection omits it once device ids are issued.

device_used.description: DD-A32: cpu when a CPU-only runner mapped the assigned cuda:0 to cpu.

externalised_detail.description: DD-A33: per-sample / latency samples moved to an artifact (artifact_id, relpath, sha256, bytes, counts).

signature.description: Evaluator signature of an official evaluation row (evaluation_signature elsewhere).

source.description: Official evaluation rows: weights source label (official_weights).

raw_metrics.description: Raw evaluator outputs, 1.5.0 allowlist (DD-A19 / analysis decision D4): measurement values, definitions and hashes. Host paths of checkpoints and weights, the stage-trainer result, server error strings and the GPU UUID are never sent.

fitness_weights.description: Named weights of the source rung applied to this row.

postprocess_runtime.description: Implementation of the post-processing timed in forward_and_postprocess (S8-F5). Rows with different values are not comparable latencies.

checkpoint_state.description: State of checkpoint_path on disk: PRUNED = removed by the run retention policy (recorded), MISSING = absent without a record (S10-F4).

training_status.description: TRAINED when at least one training epoch of this trial completed (epochs >= 1) or the trial evaluated existing trained weights (training mode evaluate_only or pretrained); UNTRAINED otherwise. Display vocabulary only (DD-A23): run/candidate/evaluation status enums are unchanged; the web badge "UNTRAINED · UNEVALUATED" is training_status UNTRAINED together with evaluation_status NOT_EVALUATED.

immutable.description: true once the row is a committed measurement.

source_kind.description: Explicit training rows: kind of the selected source.

training_mode.description: Explicit training rows: requested training mode.

performance_status.description: NOT_EVALUATED on rows that measured nothing.

representative_rule.description: current-rung highest fitness → lower latency → stable candidate id

Generation.description: Complete only when planning_closed=true and pending_count=0. Server semantically enforces evaluated_count+failed_count+not_admitted_count+pending_count=planned_count. No representative/line when no valid measured evaluation exists.

ga_billed_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

random_billed_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

actual_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

baseline_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

final_gpu_seconds.description: Measured GPU seconds; null/absent until available

profile_gpu_seconds.description: Physical GPU seconds of device profiling: BENCHMARK jobs and the inline latency measurement inside training jobs (ledger kind profile, meta.source inline_latency). Never billed to a search arm and never charged against a cap. Runs created before 2026-10-07T13:03:46Z (the first post-fix run is run-e4c9b809b433) keep inline profiling inside their train rows and have no profile_gpu_seconds.

overshoot_gpu_seconds.description: Sum of the per-cap overshoots max(0, consumed - cap). Per-cap keys are overshoot_gpu_seconds.<GA|IndependentRandom>.seed_<seed>, overshoot_gpu_seconds.Baseline, overshoot_gpu_seconds.Final (present only when the cap exists and time was charged to it; 0.0 is a measured value). The first attempt that crosses a cap logs reason BUDGET_OVERSHOOT {arm, search_seed, job_id, candidate_id, attempt, cap_s, billed_before_s, billed_s, overshoot_s}. Absent on runs whose costs were last refreshed before contract 1.2.6; present (0.0 when not exceeded) after the next refresh.

final_gpu_seconds_children.description: On a SEARCH run: physical GPU seconds of its FINAL_RETRAIN child runs.

purpose.description: e.g. SMOKE for PILOT_SMOKE preset runs.

source_commit.description: Server source identifier (git SHA or source tree sha256).

protocol_canonicalization.description: Canonical JSON + hash algorithm version, e.g. mbnas-canon/1 sha256.

budget.description: Frozen budget per arm/seed in GPU-seconds and the admission bookkeeping. 1.5.0: the admission policy text is owner-only and never sent.

cancel.description: Cancel tracking: requested_at, scope, kill/cleanup state.

kind.description: SEARCH = baseline + GA/Random search run; FINAL_RETRAIN = separate child run created by POST /runs/{id}/final-retrain. Absent on rows written before contract 1.2.0 means SEARCH.

finalists.description: Frozen finalist list of a FINAL_RETRAIN run (highest L2 AP under the measured latency constraint, tie-break lower latency then stable candidate id, top_k per arm per seed). Empty list + reason NO_FINALIST is a valid report.

final_retrain_runs.description: FINAL_RETRAIN children of a search run.

id.description: Runner id for a runner row (core-issued at registration); an opaque id for the core-host proposal worker. Never hostname:pid.

status.description: lost = heartbeat older than the lease TTL or process SIGKILLed.

device_uuid.description: Deprecated in 1.5.0: GPU UUID of a customer (runner) device, kept for 1.4.x readers; replaced by the core-issued device_id (DD-A19 / D7) - the projection omits it once device ids are issued.

runner_id.description: Core-issued runner id (equals id on a runner row); null for the core-host proposal worker.

device_id.description: Core-issued opaque id of the runner device; null when not issued.

created_at.description: Storage time of the event (snapshot and replay rows).

message.description: Log text, scrubbed (no absolute paths, PIDs or host names).

checks.description: Resume revalidation result: codes and outcomes only.

payload.description: 1.5.0 log payload allowlist (DD-A19 / analysis decision D13); the rejected checkpoint path of a runner report is owner-only.

Event.description: SSE data JSON. seq is run-local and monotonic; duplicates/out-of-order must be deduplicated by the client; gaps require a snapshot. generation.updated carries the current Generation row (live counts) after each change while the generation is open; generation.completed is sent exactly once, on the transition to complete. Clients upsert both by generation key.

registry_source.description: Label of the registry source (live | example); never a path.

capabilities.description: Open object. device_targets[] = {id, name, kind, available, reason}; search_space = {variant: etri_mixed|unavailable, reason, checked, fallback_policy}; per-model maps full_state_resume/export_onnx/export_trt/devices/adapter_class; sse, idempotency, signed_artifact_urls, execution_modes, registry_source. 1.5.0: no host root (the pool root and registry file paths are never sent).

environment_lock.description: Environment lock summary; 1.5.0: without the lock file path.

versions.description: Open object: python, packages, api, environment_lock.

archive_roots.description: Read-only roots served by /archive/* (MBNAS_ARCHIVE_ROOTS); separate from output_roots, never written.

allowlists.description: Customer-host roots only (DD-A19 / D8): the gateway host dataset/output roots the user may name in console.paths and the read-only archive roots. Core-internal roots are never listed.

core.description: Gateway: reachability of core (unreachable = degraded, no core sections).

gateway.description: Gateway self status (DD-A30 web dist, artifact store).

errors.description: Validation errors {field, message, code}. Codes include EPOCHS_ADDED_MANUAL (a requested rungs[i].epochs_added that differs from the computed cumulative delta; an equal echo is accepted), SEARCH_SPACE_UNAVAILABLE, WEIGHTS_SUM_NOT_ONE, ANCHORS_INVALID, and the PLAN.md §4 list.

resolved.description: Resolved protocol (Protocol shape) or null when invalid; 1.5.0: no resolution.paths.*.realpath and no search_space_resolved.etri_root.

capabilities.description: Open object. search_space = {variant, allow_native_fallback, detail, probe {available, reason, checked}} (1.5.0: no pool root). warnings.description: Warnings {field, message, code}; codes include PROXY_PIPELINE_UNAVAILABLE, SEARCH_SPACE_FALLBACK, HORIZON_ADJUSTED, LEGACY_ALIAS.

resolved_diff.description: Every field whose resolved value differs from the request (e.g. optimizer=auto → actual lr, requested vs resolved image shape, execution_mode defaulted to PILOT). Empty when valid=false: an invalid result makes no resolution claim.

validation_id.description: Server-side id of the frozen validated snapshot; Run may send it to prove non-stale validation.

created.description: false when the idempotency key replayed an existing run.

code.description: Machine code. Server-side contract violations of a response are reported as 500 RESPONSE_CONTRACT_VIOLATION (the response is withheld rather than sent malformed).

message.description: Safe text: no host paths, roots or tracebacks.

location.description: Component that produced the error (mbnas_contracts.errors.ErrorLocation): gateway, core (relayed unchanged; CORE_UNAVAILABLE when unreachable), runner (reported through core) or store (gateway artifact/upload store).

devices.description: Map target id (host-gpu-0, jetson-orin-nx, jetson-orin-nano, jetson-agx-orin) -> device capability.

conditions.description: Conditions of the run (dataset, split, stage, epochs, protocol hash, device, precision, checkpoint) read from its artifacts; any member that cannot be read is null. Optional: absent on servers that do not provide it.

duplicate_scope.description: Duplicate architectures are rejected inside one seed journal only; seeds never share duplicate detection (seed independence, replay). Candidates generated before this field existed report per_seed, the policy that applied.

execution.description: Where the structural build ran. CPU for every generation-only job, whichever worker leased it (the child process runs with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty); null for candidates recorded before the field existed.

training_status.description: Always UNTRAINED: generation never trains (same UNTRAINED|TRAINED vocabulary as CandidateEvaluation). Display vocabulary only (DD-A23): run/candidate/evaluation status enums are unchanged; the web badge "UNTRAINED · UNEVALUATED" is training_status UNTRAINED together with evaluation_status NOT_EVALUATED.

architecture_path.description: 1.5.0 public value: never an absolute host path - the path relative to the run directory (the prefix up to and including the run id segment removed) or, for a file outside the run directory, its file name; the file itself is downloaded through artifacts[] (checkpoint id / artifact id), never by path.

GeneratedCandidate.description: Generation results in proposal order. No evaluation row or measured performance is invented.

upload_id.description: Browser to gateway: id from POST /uploads/model-config. The gateway replaces it with model_yaml_text + source_sha256 before relaying to core.

model_yaml_text.description: Gateway to core: the uploaded YAML text (UTF-8, up to 1 MiB), with source_sha256. A browser sends upload_id instead.

source_sha256.description: sha256 of the original upload bytes (UploadResponse.source_sha256; the sha256: prefix is optional); required with model_yaml_text.

model_name.description: Optional file name of the uploaded model (used for the scale rule and the document name).

source.description: Immutable source of the new trial. baseline needs baseline_id; user needs upload_id (browser to gateway; the gateway relays model_yaml_text + source_sha256 to core, which never receives a path) or model_path (legacy owner-local server path); exactly one of the three. search and generated need run_id and candidate_id. upload_id, model_yaml_text, source_sha256 and model_name are valid for a user source only.

checkpoint.description: Default null; only meaningful for mode resume. Omitted or null: the ordinary run Resume path (the same checks as POST /runs/{run_id}/resume; a run paused before its first epoch has no full-state yet and is resumed from its start). A path: it must equal the latest training_full checkpoint this server recorded for the candidate; the candidate has no recorded training_full at all -> 409 EXTERNAL_CHECKPOINT_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED (an external file is never imported into a run); a recorded one that differs -> 409 RESUME_CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH.

TrainingRequest.description: Explicit single-model training/evaluation selection (POST /training-runs). source.kind baseline needs baseline_id; user needs upload_id (POST /uploads/model-config; the gateway relays the text as model_yaml_text + source_sha256) or a legacy model_path; search|generated need run_id and candidate_id of the immutable source run. mode=resume continues the latest RECORDED training_full checkpoint of an existing run (a request without checkpoint takes the ordinary run Resume path; a checkpoint path, if given, must be that latest recorded path: 409 RESUME_CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH when it differs, 409 EXTERNAL_CHECKPOINT_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED when the candidate has no recorded training_full at all - no external full-state import). mode=evaluate_only (official evaluation) needs no epoch target: any console.training.epoch_target_total / scheduler_horizon_epochs is ignored and the run records epoch_target_total=0 (console.extra.training.epoch_target_total) with the supplied value kept as ignored_requested_epoch_target_total (DD-31); its CandidateEvaluation rows carry epochs=0 and epoch_target_total null. All other modes require a positive epoch_target_total (422 EPOCH_TARGET_INVALID). validation_enabled=false trains without val/test data and completes as candidate/evaluation status SEARCH_COMPLETE with performance_status NOT_EVALUATED. protocol is the explicit training policy (training, fitness, hard_constraints, console.paths, console.training); the source run's evaluation switch is never inherited.

created.description: false when the idempotency key replayed an existing run, or when mode=resume continued an existing run

candidate_id.description: the single trial of the run (for mode=resume: the resumed candidate)

source_sha256.description: sha256 of the uploaded YAML bytes (user source).

model_name.description: File name of the uploaded YAML (user source).

source.description: Immutable source of the new trial. baseline needs baseline_id, user needs model_path, search and generated need run_id and candidate_id.

TrainingRunCreated.description: Response of POST /training-runs (idempotently created or resumed explicit training run).

StructureReport.description: Structure document mbnas-structure/2 of CandidateDetail.structure, POST /runs/{run_id}/candidates/{candidate_id}/structure-check, GET|POST /registry/{model_id}/structure[-check] and POST /structure-check. Additive over mbnas-structure/1 (v1 keys and values kept; saved v1 proofs are returned unchanged with schema mbnas-structure/1 and lack the v2-only keys, so every v2-only key is optional). DECLARED (D, from the configuration), DERIVED (R, computed from declared values, e.g. repeats_detail.scaled) and OBSERVED (O, read from the CPU build and forward hooks) values always live under separate keys; a derived value never fills an observed key, a connection that was not observed gets no edge (edges_unobserved), and GET endpoints never build a model. status PASS means the build and the reference forward ran and the individual rules held on the observed shapes; no executed check is UNVERIFIED, never PASS. Only values recorded by real code are present. flops is MEASURED only when a proposer counter supplied it (flops_source proposer_flop_counter); explicit checks do not count FLOPs (NOT_MEASURED). CandidateEvaluation.epoch_target_total is >= 1 or absent: an evaluate_only run records the explicit 0 in the run protocol console.extra.training.epoch_target_total, never in an evaluation row.

representation.description: D. yaml_genes (Ultralytics, ETRI mixed) | native_modules (RF-DETR, ETRI hybrid: no genes, gene keys of blocks are null).

input_size.description: Square input size of the check; candidate views fall back to the protocol requested_input_size, which may be [h, w].

fixed_resolution.description: Native backends: the single input size the model is built for (RF-DETR preset resolution, ETRI hybrid imgsz). POST /registry/{model_id}/structure-check answers another size with 422 INPUT_SIZE_INVALID (no document); the candidate structure-check route and adapter-level checks still return a FAIL document with the diagnostic INPUT_SIZE_INVALID. Absent for YAML documents.

evidence_source.description: Where the document comes from. Values written by the server: saved_structure_check (recorded check of this exact configuration; candidate and registry views), declared_configuration (declaration only, nothing was built), executed_structure_check (the answer of an explicit check: the two POST structure routes). Free string on purpose: consumers must not fail on a value they do not know. Absent on the document of a freshly executed candidate check.

source.description: Candidate views: recorded source of the model (audit.source / training_source).

configuration.description: Candidate views: which configuration the rows describe {kind execution|normalized|original|generated, yaml_hash, path, availability}. 1.5.0 public value: never an absolute host path - the path relative to the run directory (the prefix up to and including the run id segment removed) or, for a file outside the run directory, its file name; the file itself is downloaded through artifacts[] (checkpoint id / artifact id), never by path.

native_config.description: Native backends (DECLARED): the model configuration the document was built from (for example encoder, out_feature_indexes, dec_layers, hidden_dim, patch_size for RF-DETR; family, imgsz, patch, dim, depth, heads for the ETRI hybrid). Never an observed value.

yaml_hash.description: Hash of the canonical YAML dict (not of the file bytes; the file sha256 can differ).

architecture_hash.description: O. Set only after a build.

observation.description: OBSERVED (O). CPU environment of the check that produced the observed values; null for a declaration-only document, a static FAIL and an UNVERIFIED document (nothing ran). A reused proposer report keeps the environment of its own run (report_origin supplied).

imgsz.description: Input size of the reference forward.

parser_source_sha256.description: sha256 of the source of the model parser registered in the checking process (recorded for ordinary YAML as well). It identifies the parser code that built the model, not the YAML file and not the architecture; a different value means a different parser, not a different model.

fx_traceable.description: false for native backends (hook observation instead of torch.fx).

fx_basis.description: Native backends: why fx_traceable is false. torch.fx is not called; the constant is taken from the adapter inventory, not re-measured by the check.

dinov2_weights.description: RF-DETR only: whether pretrained DINOv2 weights were loaded for the check; null for other backends.

source_blob_sha1.description: ETRI hybrid: git blob sha1 of the notebook the module source comes from (recorded, not recomputed by the check).

checked_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 time of the check.

report_origin.description: executed = this check ran the build and forward; supplied = a report recorded earlier (e.g. by the proposer) was reused.

environment_recorded.description: false only when a supplied report carried no environment.

id.description: block-NNNN (kept for URLs and v1 consumers); equals block_id.

module.description: DECLARED (D) operator name from the YAML row.

module_class.description: OBSERVED (O) type(m).__name__ of the built module.

wrapper.description: nn.Sequential when the parser wrapped a repeated block.

native_path.description: YAML backend: model.{i}; native backends: named_children path (e.g. transformer.decoder.layers.1).

native_kind.description: Native backends: module = a torch module with a forward; buffer = a registered tensor or parameter table shown as a block (learned query tables); null for YAML blocks.

section.description: YAML backend backbone|neck|head; native backends backbone|transformer|head|stem|encoder.

section_basis.description: Why the section was assigned (yaml:backbone | yaml:head+detection_module | derived:non-detection head row -> neck | native:<path prefix>); shown as is.

catalog.description: Design origin of the block (DD-38): origin_family, introduced_in, role, reference, notes from the static catalog; source_path only on documents an explicit check produced. Absent on documents saved before contract 1.4.2 (absent is not "unknown").

native_config.description: Native backends (DECLARED): configuration values that belong to this block only; null when there are none.

note.description: Native backends: a remark about how the block was observed; null when none.

repeats_detail.description: The three repeat counts kept apart: declared (D), scaled (R, depth formula), observed (O, from the built module; null when not observed).

declared_basis.description: Native backends: which configuration value declared is (for example dec_layers).

observed_basis.description: Native backends: what observed counts (for example len(transformer.decoder.layers), Embedding.num_embeddings for a learned query table). Read it before treating observed as a layer count.

group.description: Native backends: repeat_groups[].group this block is a unit of; null otherwise.

unit_index.description: Native backends: zero-based position of the block inside its group.

effective.description: OBSERVED (O) values read from the built module and the forward hooks; null members mean "not observed", never a derived substitute.

c_in.description: Sum of the delivered input channels.

inputs.description: Tensors actually delivered, one per source (list-from rows have several).

source.description: Index of the source block; -1 = the model input image (same convention as the YAML from field). null when the tensor could not be attributed to a block.

source_path.description: Native backends: native path of the source module (model_input for the image). Present when the source is known.

name.description: Native backends: the hooked argument name (arg0, or the keyword).

shape.description: Native backends: the full tensor shape, batch axis included.

outputs.description: Shape without batch axis of every returned tensor (Detect returns mixed ranks).

repeats.description: Observed repeat count (len of m.m / m.blocks / Sequential); null when not observed. The depth-scaled formula value is repeats_scaled.

repeats_scaled.description: DERIVED (R): the parser depth formula applied to the declared repeats.

repeats_source.description: Where the observed repeat count was read (.m, .blocks, sequential_wrapper, sequential, single_module, unobserved). Counts that fit none of these (ModuleList length, number of output feature maps, rows of a learned query table) are reported as null here and named in repeats_detail.observed_basis; the enum has no value for them in 1.4.1.

nl.description: Detection head only: number of detection levels.

nc.description: Detection head only: head class count.

observed_at_failure.description: true on the failing row of a FAIL document, whose inputs are the tensors that reached it.

calls.description: Native backends: how many times the forward hook saw the module run during the reference forward.

output_shapes.description: Native backends: the exact tensor shapes of the first call, batch axis included (outputs strips the batch axis). RF-DETR heads carry a leading decoder-layer axis here.

observed_children.description: Native backends: container modules (ModuleList/ModuleDict) have no forward; the first elements were hooked instead: [{path, module, calls, inputs, outputs}].

buffers.description: Native backends: for a buffer block, [{name, shape}] of the tensor.

tokens_out.description: ETRI hybrid: token count of a block whose output is a token sequence [1, tokens, dim] (h_out/w_out stay null).

internal_layers.description: OBSERVED (O) named_modules of this block. A module instance shared by several blocks (e.g. Conv.default_act) appears under every block with shared true.

shared.description: null only for legacy reports without per-block records.

catalog_summary.description: Design-origin distribution of the blocks (DD-38): by_origin_family counts the blocks per known family, unknown the blocks whose blocks[].catalog.origin_family is null. Absent on documents saved before contract 1.4.2.

edges.description: Observed or declared connections only; no edge is invented.

connection_source.description: yaml_from (D) | native_fixed (code-fixed flow) | observed (seen through hooks only). Absent in v1.

evidence.description: Native backends: why the edge exists. kind tensor_identity = the same tensor object left the source and entered the target (OBSERVED through hooks; tensors names the arguments, shape the tensor shape); kind code_fixed+shape = a flow fixed in the model code (citation names where) that the hooked shapes corroborate or contradict (corroboration is the explanation, corroborated the verdict).

edges_unobserved.description: Native backends: modules whose input/output could not be observed (e.g. inside the decoder). [] for the YAML backend.

observed_scopes.description: Native backends (OBSERVED): hook records of the container modules that have no block of their own (RF-DETR backbone Joiner and transformer): [{module_path, module_class, calls, inputs, outputs}] with the input/output shapes seen. [] when there is none.

repeat_groups.description: Native backends: repeated units that were split into one block each: [{group, declared, declared_basis, observed, blocks[]}]; declared is the configured count (null when the configuration has none), observed the counted length of the module container, blocks the ids of the unit blocks.

parameters_unattributed.description: Native backends: model parameters minus the sum of the block parameters (signed). 0 means every parameter is attributed to a listed block; the server never hides a remainder.

parameter_free_modules_not_listed.description: Native backends: paths of parameter-free modules that were not given a block of their own (activation, dropout and similar); [] when none were skipped.

runtime_requirements.description: UNVERIFIED native documents caused by a missing runtime: {python, packages[]} the check needs (for example rfdetr==1.11.2). null otherwise.

scale_source.description: YAML documents of the registry and the user-YAML routes: where the model scale came from. yaml = the file names a valid scale; file_name = guessed from the file name like ultralytics; file_name_suffix = a trailing -<letter>; first_scale_key = the first key of scales (the parser fallback). null when the YAML has no scales.

method.description: Proposal method of a searched candidate.

anyOf.description: Structured template reference {id, family, variant} of the searched genotype.

template.description: Seed template id, or the stored {id, family, variant} object.

template_detail.description: Structured template reference {id, family, variant} of the searched genotype.

search_space.description: Search-space version and variant label only.

init.description: Initialisation of a final or explicit training trial.

recipe.description: Pinned recipe of a final trial.

source_template.description: Baseline lineage: registry id of the baseline.

training_source.description: Explicit training: the selected source binding.

lineage.description: 1.5.0 public lineage (DD-A19): operation, method, parents, parent_evaluation_ids, template (+ template_detail), search_space {version, variant} and the final / baseline / explicit training keys. Crossover cut/mask, mutation and repair events, prior draw, tournament selection, parent rows, elitism flag, notes and the space/prior hashes are owner-only (/core/v1/owner/*) and never sent.

lineage_status.description: RECORDED | NOT_APPLICABLE (native backends have no lineage).

code.description: e.g. SHAPE_MISMATCH, MERGE_INPUT_MISMATCH, HEAD_INPUT_INVALID, CLASS_COUNT_INVALID, INPUT_SIZE_INVALID, BLOCK_UNSUPPORTED, STRUCTURE_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE (UNVERIFIED: the CPU runtime or the offline weights are missing), STRUCTURE_CHECK_FAILED (a non-environment exception ended the build or forward; the check did not complete), STRUCTURE_CHECK_NOT_RECORDED, CLASS_COUNT_UNKNOWN (native candidate whose run dataset YAML could not be read, so no check ran), GENE_REPRESENTATION_NOT_APPLICABLE (UNVERIFIED: this model has no gene representation for the requested view; not a failure).

evidence_level.description: A check without a rule of its own that passes only because the forward succeeded is derived_from_forward.

rows_checked.description: Rows or pairs the rule looked at; 0 means the rule had nothing to judge.

reason_code.description: Candidate audit only: STRUCTURE_FAILED (status FAIL) or STRUCTURE_UNVERIFIED (status UNVERIFIED) on a candidate the evaluation-ON proposer marked INVALID.

GENE_REPRESENTATION_NOT_APPLICABLE: the model has no gene representation for the requested view (status UNVERIFIED, not a failure). CLASS_COUNT_UNKNOWN (1.4.1): a native candidate whose run dataset YAML cannot be read, so the check did not run (UNVERIFIED). STRUCTURE_CHECK_FAILED (1.4.1): a non-environment exception ended the build or forward (the YAML path uses it as well). CLASS_COUNT_INVALID, HEAD_INPUT_INVALID and SHAPE_MISMATCH are reused for native heads and edges.
x-status-vocabulary.error_codes_note: POST /training-runs mode=resume (DD-36): a request without checkpoint is not a 409 for a missing full-state, it takes the ordinary run Resume path. EXTERNAL_CHECKPOINT_IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED (409) is raised only when a checkpoint path was sent and the candidate has no recorded training_full; RESUME_CHECKPOINT_MISMATCH (409, existing since 1.3.x) when a path was sent and differs from the latest recorded one. FINAL_RETRAIN_NOT_APPLICABLE (409): POST /runs/{id}/final-retrain on a run whose resolved console.search.evaluation_enabled is false. POST /training-runs 422 (training selection, named since 1.4.3): DEVICE_UNSUPPORTED - the resolved training device is not cuda:0 (the worker exposes its assigned GPU as cuda:0); EVAL_ONLY_UNSUPPORTED - mode evaluate_only is accepted only for a verified official ultralytics baseline (a baseline of another backend, a user model and a search/generated candidate are refused; candidate checkpoints are evaluated from their run); VALIDATION_DISABLED_UNSUPPORTED - validation=false is implemented for the ultralytics backend only; INITIAL_WEIGHTS_REQUIRED - mode pretrained or evaluate_only found no existing server weights file (give checkpoint for a user or candidate model; a baseline needs registered official weights); RESUME_SOURCE_REQUIRED - mode resume needs source.run_id and source.candidate_id of the existing training run. 1.5.0: uploads (POST /uploads/model-config and the upload_id of POST /structure-check and POST /training-runs) - PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE 413, UPLOAD_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED / UPLOAD_EMPTY / UPLOAD_NOT_UTF8 / UPLOAD_INVALID / UPLOAD_ID_INVALID 422, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND 404, UPLOAD_CORRUPT 409, STORE_UNAVAILABLE 507; carried text - SOURCE_SHA256_INVALID / SOURCE_SHA256_MISMATCH 422; gateway relay (Error.location core) - CORE_UNAVAILABLE 503, CORE_BAD_RESPONSE 502, CORE_AUTH_FAILED 502; gateway limits - RATE_LIMITED 429 (Retry-After); stored bytes - ARTIFACT_NOT_READY 404, LOAD_FAILED 409.
